description: @ten3roberts I have to change a little bit on your previous implementation on Migrating. I hope it makes sense.

comments.body:
I think it would be better to fail and return an error, rather than just printing text and exiting with SUCCESS.

Something like `=> anyhow::bail!("Unknown file type")` etc.

Silent errors that proceed anyways can be very frustrating since you easily miss a single line in the terminal if the rest of the command proceeds.
I think I'd prefer to add `use toml::Value` and `use std::path::Path` etc to reduce the noise in the function body 😊

Same in here.

No need to repeat `std` all the time, it makes it more difficult to read
